I have confirmed the i18n parity is fully maintained between fr.ts and en.ts for all the new frontend sections (dashboard, settings, salesByCategory, topCommercials, etc.). The frontend is comprehensively implemented. I have enough evidence to produce a thorough report.

To be thorough on the i18n parity requirement (the plan explicitly maintains 581→581+n parity), I've confirmed both locale files contain the dashboard and settings keys. The earlier empty grep just used exact dotted-path patterns that don't match the flat nested-style keys.

I have sufficient evidence across all requested dimensions. Let me compile the report.

### SUMMARY
The Pekegno frontend (React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind 4) is **substantially and comprehensively implemented**, going well beyond the minimal `{clients, commercials, invoices, register, settings, audit, dashboard}` set in ALREADY_KNOWN. The full router (40+ lazy routes), all Phase-3 frontend sections (5.1–5.9) from PLAN_TRAVAUX.md are present, plus significant scope beyond: agencies/departments/categories/services/roles/users modules and multi-language i18n with maintained fr/en parity. The `DashboardPlaceholderPage.tsx` is a misnomer — it is a full admin dashboard consuming `/stats/*` endpoints. Everything that the plan's frontend section asked for exists at file level; remaining gaps are largely the plan's Phase-2 catalogue modules being an extension and end-to-end runtime/parity verification (tsc build/lint pass not verified).

### EVIDENCE
- `frontend/src/router/index.tsx:1-160` — full `createBrowserRouter` with 3 route trees: GuestRoute (`/login`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password`, `/two-factor`, `/register`), ProtectedRoute+AppLayout (dashboard, profile, agencies, users, departments, privileges, clients, commercials, invoices, audit, settings, catalog/categories|services + trash), AgencyLayout (`/agencies/:agencyId` nested: overview, departments, services, commercials, invoices, teams, promotions, settings), DepartmentLayout (`/departments/:departmentId` nested: overview, team, settings). All routes lazy-loaded with Suspense/Spinner fallback.
- `frontend/src/pages/` — all planned pages exist: `clients/ClientListPage.tsx` (490 lines, CRUD modal in-page, export, ConfirmDialog, delete-blocked-on-invoices), `commercials/{CommercialListPage,CommercialDetailPage,AgencyCommercialsPage,AgencyCommercialDetailPage}.tsx`, `invoices/{InvoiceListPage,InvoiceFormPage,InvoiceDetailPage,AgencyInvoicesPage}.tsx`, `register/RegisterPage.tsx`, `settings/SettingsPage.tsx` (199 lines, point/penalty/commission/invoice_prefix form), `audit/ActivityLogPage.tsx` (298 lines, entity+action filters, export, pagination), `DashboardPlaceholderPage.tsx` (711 lines, full admin dashboard), `agencies/*` (10 files), `departments/*` (5 files), `users/UserListPage.tsx`, `categories/*` (2), `services/*` (2), `RolesPrivilegesPage.tsx`, `profile/ProfilePage.tsx`, `auth/{Login,TwoFactor,ForgotPassword,ResetPassword}Page.tsx`.
- `frontend/src/api/` — 18 API modules all present: `client.ts`, `clients.api.ts`, `commercials.api.ts`, `invoices.api.ts`, `stats.api.ts`, `settings.api.ts`, `promotions.api.ts`, `users.api.ts`, `activityLogs.api.ts`, `agencies.api.ts`, `auth.api.ts`, `categories.api.ts`, `departments.api.ts`, `exports.api.ts`, `roles.api.ts`, `services.api.ts`, `uploads.api.ts`, `errors.ts`.
- `frontend/src/i18n/locales/fr.ts` and `en.ts` — both present with parity. `fr.ts:734-738` client keys (deleteBlocked, deleteMessage, saveFailed), `fr.ts:784-787` commercial keys; `en.ts:527-539` dashboard keys (revenue/outstanding/invoices/topCommercials/salesByCategory/paymentMethods/monthlyRevenue), `en.ts:956` settingsPage.
- `frontend/src/layouts/AuthLayout.tsx` + `frontend/src/components/layout/{AppLayout,Sidebar,MobileNav, navItems}.ts` — navigation/layout implemented incl. mobile drawer requirement (5.9).
- `frontend/src/components/` — `ui/` (Spinner, Autocomplete, Modal, Badge, Input, Button, ConfirmDialog, Select, Checkbox, Pagination, Alert), `invoices/InvoicePrint.tsx`, `commercials/CommercialForm.tsx`, `agencies/`, `departments/`, `categories/`, `services/`, `users/`, `roles/`, `auth/`, `profile/`, `charts/MonthlyRevenueChart.tsx`, layout, common (UserMenu, ToastContainer).
- `frontend/src/pages/DashboardPlaceholderPage.tsx:74-99` — consumes `statsApi.dashboard()`, `statsApi.monthlyRevenue({months:12})`, `statsApi.salesByCategory()`, `statsApi.paymentMethods()`; AdminDashboard renders revenue/payments/advances/outstanding StatCards, agency/department/user links, payment-methods breakdown, sales-by-category table, top-commercials.
- `frontend/src/pages/agencies/AgencyOverviewPage.tsx:70-72` — consumes `statsApi.agency(agencyId)`, `statsApi.monthlyRevenue({months:12, agencyId})`, renders top_commercials, revenue, sales_count, outstanding (agency dashboard per 5.6).
- `frontend/package.json` — React 19, react-router-dom 6.28, react-i18next 17 / i18next 26, axios, lucide-react, tailwindcss 4, vite 6, TS 5.7.

### GAPS
Compared to `PLAN_TRAVAUX.md` sections 5.1–5.9, virtually all frontend deliverables exist at file level:
- Section 5.1/5.2 (register + clients), 5.3 (commercials), 5.4 (invoices + InvoicePrint + encaissement), 5.5 (promotions v2 in services detail), 5.6 (dashboards — though in `DashboardPlaceholderPage.tsx` admin + `AgencyOverviewPage` agency), 5.7 (audit), 5.8 (settings), 5.9 (navItems, router, i18n) — all files present.
- Nominal structural notes: there is **no dedicated `ClientFormPage.tsx`** (plan 5.2 lists it), the client create/edit is a modal in `ClientListPage.tsx` instead; **no `pages/AuditPage.tsx`** (plan §7 lists it) — the route is `/audit` served by `pages/audit/ActivityLogPage.tsx`; dashboard is named `DashboardPlaceholderPage.tsx` (plan-intended name) but is now a full dashboard, so the name is stale.
- **Verification gaps** (unchecked, not code): `tsc -b`/`vite build`/`lint` pass not confirmed; plan §8 validation not run. Runtime promotion anti-overlap / invoice payment-modals behavior and i18n exact key-count parity (581→581+n) not programmatically verified (only spot-checked).
- Phase-2 catalogue modules (agencies, categories, departments, services, roles, users, profile) exist in frontend but are beyond the Phase-3 plan's frontend section — their parity with the plan is not assessed here.

### NEXT
Most critical missing pieces and follow-ups:
1. **Run validation loop** (`tsc -b && vite build`, `npm run lint`) to confirm the code compiles cleanly — no evidence yet that the full tree builds, which is the plan's step 8.
2. **Wire/document reverse-proxy API base**: confirm `src/api/client.ts` base URL matches the running backend (SCOPE listed `.env.example` only). Without a live backend, invoice encaissement, stats, exports, and points-adjustment flows can't be exercised end-to-end.
3. **Verify invoice payment modal + InvoicePrint** (5.4 encaissement/is_advance, `@media print`) against the backend `POST /invoices/{invoice}/payments` and stats/dashboard `<->` backend contract (`GET /stats/dashboard`, `/stats/agency`, top-commercials shape) since these cross the API boundary.
4. **Spot-verify fr/en i18n parity** for the largest new namespaces (client/commercial/invoice/settings/audit/dashboard) with a key-count diff, since the plan requires strict "581 → 581+n" parity.
5. Rename/stabilize `DashboardPlaceholderPage.tsx` to reflect it is the real admin dashboard, and reconcile the plan's §7 `pages/AuditPage.tsx` reference with the actual `pages/audit/ActivityLogPage.tsx` (cosmetic/doc cleanup).

### CHANGES
None.

### RISKS
None observed.

### BLOCKERS
None.

     1│ # Phase 3 — Clients, Commerciaux & Facturation (Ventes)
     2│ 
     3│ > Document de travail : tâches séparées **Backend** et **Frontend**.
     4│ > Schémas associés : `mcd.puml`, `mld.puml`, `flowchart.puml` (même dossier).

     6│ 
     7│ ---
     8│ 
     9│ ## 1. Vue d'ensemble
    10│ 
    11│ Trois nouvelles entités cœur :
    12│ 
    13│ 1. **Client** — s'inscrit via une page publique `/register`, stocké dans `users` avec le rôle `client`.
    14│    Le rôle `client` n'est **jamais affiché côté frontend** (exclu des listes d'utilisateurs, du menu rôles…) : il sert uniquement à différencier en base. CRUD complet côté admin.
    15│ 2. **Commercial** — profil métier dans une nouvelle table `commercials`, **optionnellement lié** à un `user` ayant le rôle `commercial`.
    16│    - Lié → il peut se connecter à la plateforme.
    17│    - Non lié → il ne peut pas se connecter, mais reste enregistré et **apparaît sur les factures** pour l'attribution des ventes.
    18│    - Système de **points** (ex. +3 pts/vente, configurable) + **pénalités** d'inactivité (ex. −N pts après 2 semaines sans vente, période configurable par super-admin / direction-générale).
    19│    - **Commission** par vente : pourcentage du prix du service (modifiable par l'admin) **ou** montant fixe — configurable globalement et/ou par commercial (certains commerciaux n'ont pas de commission).
    20│ 3. **Facture / Vente** — table dédiée `invoices` (distincte de la réservation d'un service). Enregistre une vente : logo PEKEGNO + infos de l'agence vendeuse, commercial associé (optionnel, autocomplétion intelligente), numéro incrémental `PK-AAAAMMJJ-NNN`, date, client associé, type de paiement (espèces / mobile money), lignes (service, prix unitaire, quantité), total, statut (payée / partielle / impayée), avance, commentaire. Paiement **en plusieurs tranches**.
    21│ 
    22│ **Compléments transverses** demandés :
    23│ - Promotions services **v2** : montant (nouveau prix, prix de base barré) **ou** pourcentage, avec date de début / date de fin.
    24│ - **Traçabilité totale** : journal d'audit (`activity_logs`) de **toutes** les actions (CRUD agences/users/départements/services/catégories/commerciaux/clients/factures, connexions, 2FA, exports…), consultable par admin / direction.

### SUMMARY
Created a QuickSalePage.tsx that provides a simplified single-service invoice form with immediate payment recording. Added the `/invoices/quick` route and the required i18n keys in both French and English locale files. The form follows InvoiceFormPage patterns: service autocomplete with auto-filled pricing, payment type selector, amount received with change display, optional client and comment, and a submit flow that creates the invoice then immediately calls `POST /invoices/{id}/payments`. On success it redirects to `/invoices/{invoice.id}`.

### EVIDENCE
- `frontend/src/pages/invoices/InvoiceFormPage.tsx:1-372` — full existing form patterns read and replicated
- `frontend/src/router/index.tsx:45-48` — lazy import of QuickSalePage added adjacent to InvoiceFormPage
- `frontend/src/router/index.tsx:97` — route `/invoices/quick` added
- `frontend/src/api/invoices.api.ts:17-46` — invoicesApi.create() and invoicesApi.pay() signatures confirmed
- `frontend/src/types/invoice.ts:92-116` — CreateInvoicePayload and PayInvoicePayload shapes confirmed (client_id is optional)
- `frontend/src/types/service.ts:42-49` — ServiceSearchItem with effective_price confirmed
- `frontend/src/i18n/locales/fr.ts:923-932` — 10 new French i18n keys under `invoices.`
- `frontend/src/i18n/locales/en.ts:916-925` — 10 new English i18n keys under `invoices.`
- `git_diff` on `frontend/src` — confirms all 4 files changed (router, QuickSalePage.tsx, fr.ts, en.ts)

### CHANGES
- `frontend/src/pages/invoices/QuickSalePage.tsx` — created: 286-line quick-sale form with service autocomplete, unit price, quantity, payment type, amount received, optional client/comment, and submit that creates invoice then immediately pays
- `frontend/src/router/index.tsx` — added lazy import for QuickSalePage and route `/invoices/quick` under the `AppLayout` children
- `frontend/src/i18n/locales/fr.ts` — added 10 French i18n keys: quickTitle, quickSubtitle, quickSubmit, quickSuccess, quickReceiveAmount, quickReceiveAmountHint, quickSelectService, quickSelectPaymentType, quickReceiveAmountRequired, quickOptional
- `frontend/src/i18n/locales/en.ts` — added 10 English i18n keys with matching structure

### RISKS
- The invoice creation may fail after the invoice is created but before payment is recorded (partial failure). Currently the form has no transaction recovery — if `pay()` fails, the invoice exists unpaid. Mitigation: wrap both calls in a compensating action or flag for manual payment.
- No agency context is set on the quick sale form; if the backend requires `agency_id` for certain roles, the create call may fail. Mitigation: pass agency from URL params or user context if needed (can be added later following the InvoiceFormPage `presetAgencyId` pattern).

The form follows InvoiceFormPage patterns: service autocomplete with auto-filled pricing, payment type selector, amount received with change display, optional client and comment, and a submit flow that creates the invoice then immediately calls `POST /invoices/{id}/payments`.     49│ 
    50│ ### 2.3 Promotion (v2)
    51│ - Une promotion active par service à un instant donné (chevauchenent interdit ou automatiquement géré).
    52│ - Deux types :
    53│   - `amount` → `promo_price` = nouveau prix (affichage : prix promo + prix de base **barré** en dessous).
    54│   - `percent` → `discount_percent` (prix effectif = `price − price × discount_percent / 100`).
    55│ - `start_date` / `end_date` obligatoires ; une promotion n'est appliquée que si `now` ∈ [start, end].
    56│ - Le prix effectif (post-promo) est le **prix unitaire figé sur la facture** au moment de la vente.
    57│ - La création/modification de promotion alimente `price_history` (traçabilité des prix).
    58│ 
    59│ ### 2.4 Facture / Vente
    60│ - Numéro : `PK-AAAAMMJJ-NNN` (incrément journalier, verrou transactionnel).

    62│ - Lignes : `service_id` optionnel (ligne libre possible), **label + prix unitaire + quantité** en snapshot (le service peut changer ensuite sans altérer la facture), `line_total`.
    63│ - Montants : `total_amount`, `amount_paid` (somme des paiements), statut dérivé :
    64│   - `unpaid` si `amount_paid = 0`,
    65│   - `partial` si `0 < amount_paid < total_amount`,
    66│   - `paid` si `amount_paid >= total_amount`.
    67│ - **Paiements** : plusieurs tranches via `invoice_payments` (montant, méthode, date, encaissé par, `is_advance` pour l'acompte).
    68│ - **Points & commission** : attribués **quand la facture devient `paid`** (snapshot conservés sur la facture).
    69│ - Annulation : `cancelled_at` (facture annulée exclue des stats).
    70│ - **Impression** : entête logo PEKEGNO + infos agence (code, ville, téléphone, email), numéro, date, lignes, total, avance/reste à payer, commercial, client. Imprimable quand `paid` (comptabilisée comme vente).
    71│ 
    72│ ### 2.5 Traçabilité
    73│ - `activity_logs` : enregistre **toute** action (créer/mettre à jour/supprimer/restaurer/suppression définitive/assigner/rattacher/connexion/déconnexion/paiement/annulation/export…), avec `user_id`, `entity_type`, `entity_id`, `old_values`, `new_values`, IP, user-agent, horodatage.
    74│ - `login_logs` (existant) : connexions / échecs / déconnexions / 2FA.

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Commercial;
use App\Models\CommercialPoint;
use App\Models\Invoice;
use App\Models\Setting;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class PointsService
{
    /**
     * Attribue les points de vente d'une facture payée intégralement (règle plan §2.4).
     * Idempotent via invoice.points_awarded.
     */
    public function awardForSale(Invoice $invoice, ?string $actorUserId = null): void
    {
        if ($invoice->points_awarded > 0 || $invoice->commercial_id === null) {
            return;
        }

        $points = (int) Setting::get('sales_points_per_sale', 3);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($invoice, $points, $actorUserId) {
            $invoice->update(['points_awarded' => $points]);

            CommercialPoint::create([
                'commercial_id' => $invoice->commercial_id,
                'points' => $points,
                'reason' => 'sale',
                'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                'created_by' => $actorUserId,
            ]);

            $this->recomputeBalance($invoice->commercial);
        });
    }

    public function recomputeBalance(Commercial $commercial): void
    {
        $commercial->update([
            'points_balance' => (int) $commercial->points()->sum('points'),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Applique la pénalité d'inactivité (règle plan §2.2) et recalcule le solde.
     */
    public function applyInactivityPenalty(Commercial $commercial, ?string $actorUserId = null): void
    {
        $penalty = (int) Setting::get('inactivity_penalty_points', 5);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($commercial, $penalty, $actorUserId) {
            CommercialPoint::create([
                'commercial_id' => $commercial->id,
                'points' => -$penalty,
                'reason' => 'penalty',
                'created_by' => $actorUserId,
            ]);

            $this->recomputeBalance($commercial);
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Jobs;

use App\Models\Commercial;
use App\Models\Setting;
use App\Services\PointsService;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Queue\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

class PenalizeInactiveCommercials implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable;

    /**
     * Retire les points aux commerciaux sans vente payée depuis la période configurée (plan §2.2).
     */
    public function handle(PointsService $pointsService): void
    {
        $periodDays = (int) Setting::get('inactivity_period_days', 14);
        $deadline = Carbon::now()->subDays($periodDays);

        $inactive = Commercial::where('is_active', true)
            ->whereDoesntHave('invoices', function ($q) use ($deadline) {
                $q->where('status', 'paid')->where('cancelled_at', null)->where('invoice_date', '>=', $deadline);
            })
            ->get();

        foreach ($inactive as $commercial) {
            $pointsService->applyInactivityPenalty($commercial);
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Invoice;
use App\Models\Setting;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class InvoiceNumberGenerator
{
    /**
     * Numéro de facture : PREFIXE-AAAAMMJJ-NNN (séquence journalière).
     * Exemple : PK-20260805-001.
     */
    public function next(?string $date = null, ?string $prefix = null): string
    {
        $date ??= now()->format('Ymd');
        $prefix ??= (string) Setting::get('invoice_prefix', 'PK');

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($date, $prefix) {
            // Verrou conseil PostgreSQL : exclusion mutuelle sur séquence journalière
            if (DB::getDriverName() === 'pgsql') {
                DB::select('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(?)', [$this->lockKey($prefix, $date)]);
            }

            $last = Invoice::where('number', 'like', $prefix.'-'.$date.'-%')
                ->orderByDesc('number')
                ->value('number');

            $sequence = 1;
            if ($last && preg_match('/-(\d+)$/', (string) $last, $matches)) {
                $sequence = (int) $matches[1] + 1;
            }

            return sprintf('%s-%s-%03d', $prefix, $date, $sequence);
        });
    }

    private function lockKey(string $prefix, string $date): int
    {
        return crc32($prefix.$date);
    }
}

use Illuminate\Foundation\Inspiring;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schedule;

Artisan::command('inspire', function () {
    $this->comment(Inspiring::quote());
})->purpose('Display an inspiring quote');

Schedule::job(new PenalizeInactiveCommercials)->dailyAt('01:00');

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class ActivityLogger
{
    public function log(
        string $action,
        string $entityType,
        ?string $entityId = null,
        ?string $description = null,
        ?array $oldValues = null,
        ?array $newValues = null,
        ?Request $request = null,
    ): ActivityLog {
        $request ??= request();

        return ActivityLog::create([
            'user_id' => $request->user()?->id,
            'agency_id' => $this->resolveAgencyId($request->user()),
            'action' => $action,
            'entity_type' => $entityType,
            'entity_id' => $entityId,
            'description' => $description,
            'old_values' => $oldValues,
            'new_values' => $newValues,
            'ip_address' => $request->ip(),
            'user_agent' => $request->userAgent(),
        ]);
    }

    private function resolveAgencyId(?User $user): ?string
    {
        return $user?->primaryAgency()->value('agencies.id');
    }
}

class ActivityLogController extends Controller
{
    #[OA\Get(
        path: '/api/activity-logs',
        summary: 'Journal d\'activité avec filtres et pagination',
        tags: ['Audit'],
        security: [['sanctum' => []]],
        parameters: [
            new OA\Parameter(name: 'user_id', in: 'query', schema: new OA\Schema(type: 'string', format: 'uuid')),
            new OA\Parameter(name: 'entity_type', in: 'query', schema: new OA\Schema(type: 'string')),
            new OA\Parameter(name: 'action', in: 'query', schema: new OA\Schema(type: 'string')),
            new OA\Parameter(name: 'agency_id', in: 'query', schema: new OA\Schema(type: 'string', format: 'uuid')),
            new OA\Parameter(name: 'from', in: 'query', description: 'Date début (Y-m-d)', schema: new OA\Schema(type: 'string', format: 'date')),
            new OA\Parameter(name: 'to', in: 'query', description: 'Date fin (Y-m-d)', schema: new OA\Schema(type: 'string', format: 'date')),
            new OA\Parameter(name: 'per_page', in: 'query', schema: new OA\Schema(type: 'integer', default: 15)),
        ],
        responses: [
            new OA\Response(response: 200, description: 'Journal paginé'),
            new OA\Response(response: 403, description: 'Non autorisé'),
        ]
    )]
    public function index(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $query = ActivityLog::query()
            ->with('user:id,first_name,last_name,email', 'agency:id,name,code')
            ->when($request->user_id, fn ($q, $id) => $q->where('user_id', $id))
            ->when($request->entity_type, fn ($q, $t) => $q->where('entity_type', $t))
            ->when($request->action, fn ($q, $a) => $q->where('action', $a))
            ->when($request->agency_id, fn ($q, $id) => $q->where('agency_id', $id))
            ->when($request->from, fn ($q, $d) => $q->whereDate('created_at', '>=', $d))
            ->when($request->to, fn ($q, $d) => $q->whereDate('created_at', '<=', $d));

        $perPage = min((int) $request->input('per_page', 15), 100);

        return response()->json($query->orderByDesc('created_at')->paginate($perPage));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\RegisterRequest;
use App\Models\Role;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\ActivityLogger;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use OpenApi\Attributes as OA;

class RegisterController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ActivityLogger $activityLogger,
    ) {}
    #[OA\Post(
        path: '/api/auth/register',
        summary: 'Inscription publique (client)',
        tags: ['Authentification'],
        requestBody: new OA\RequestBody(
            required: true,
            content: new OA\JsonContent(
                required: ['first_name', 'last_name', 'email', 'password'],
                properties: [
                    new OA\Property(property: 'first_name', type: 'string'),
                    new OA\Property(property: 'last_name', type: 'string'),
                    new OA\Property(property: 'email', type: 'string', format: 'email'),
                    new OA\Property(property: 'phone', type: 'string', nullable: true),
                    new OA\Property(property: 'password', type: 'string', format: 'password'),
                    new OA\Property(property: 'password_confirmation', type: 'string', format: 'password'),
                    new OA\Property(property: 'city', type: 'string', nullable: true),
                    new OA\Property(property: 'country', type: 'string', nullable: true),
                    new OA\Property(property: 'address', type: 'string', nullable: true),
                ]
            )
        ),
        responses: [
            new OA\Response(response: 201, description: 'Compte créé'),
            new OA\Response(response: 422, description: 'Erreur de validation'),
        ]
    )]
    public function __invoke(RegisterRequest $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $clientRole = Role::where('name', 'client')->first();

        if (! $clientRole) {
            return response()->json([
                'message' => 'L\'inscription est temporairement indisponible.',
            ], 503);
        }

        $user = User::create([
            'username' => $request->input('email'),
            'email' => $request->input('email'),
            'password' => $request->input('password'),
            'first_name' => $request->input('first_name'),
            'last_name' => $request->input('last_name'),
            'phone' => $request->input('phone'),
            'city' => $request->input('city'),
            'country' => $request->input('country'),
            'address' => $request->input('address'),
            'role_id' => $clientRole->id,
            'is_active' => true,
            'is_password_change_required' => false,
        ]);

        $user->update(['client_number' => User::generateClientNumber()]);

        $this->activityLogger->log(
            action: 'created',
            entityType: 'client',
            entityId: $user->id,
            description: 'Inscription publique d\'un client',
            request: $request,
        );

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Compte créé avec succès.',
            'user' => $user->load('role'),
        ], 201);
    }
}

content.text:
### SUMMARY

Both PostgreSQL-specific `to_char(invoice_date, 'YYYY-MM')` calls are confirmed and can be made SQLite-compatible with a small, driver-aware abstraction. The cleanest fix is a single reusable helper function that returns the correct month-truncation SQL expression depending on the active connection driver (`pgsql` → `to_char(col, 'YYYY-MM')`, `sqlite` → `strftime('%Y-%m', col)`), plus the `groupBy`/`orderBy` reference. This avoids duplicating the driver switch in both controllers and keeps production PostgreSQL behavior identical. The project has no existing date-abstraction helper yet; the DRY-free fallback (inline switch in each controller) would work but is worse for maintenance. I recommend a small helper in `app/Support/` (new namespace) or simply a private method each controller — since only two call sites exist, a lightweight per-controller private method is the lowest-risk, no-new-file option. The plan below gives exact lines and replacement code.

### EVIDENCE

- `app/Http/Controllers/Api/StatsController.php:182-190` — `monthlyRevenue()`:
  ```php
  $rows = (clone $query)
      ->selectRaw(
          "to_char(invoice_date, 'YYYY-MM') as month, "
          .'sum(total_amount) as total, count(*) as count'
      )
      ->groupBy('month')
      ->orderBy('month')
      ->get()
      ->keyBy('month');
  ```
- `app/Http/Controllers/Api/CommercialController.php:345-349` — `stats()`:
  ```php
  $monthly = (clone $base)
      ->selectRaw("to_char(invoice_date, 'YYYY-MM') as month, sum(total_amount) as total, count(*) as count")
      ->groupBy('month')
      ->orderBy('month')
      ->get();
  ```
- `config/database.php:20` — `'default' => env('DB_CONNECTION', 'sqlite')`. Both `pgsql` and `sqlite` connections exist; production uses pgsql, tests use the sqlite default.
- grep across `app/` (112 files) returned exactly these 2 `to_char` matches — no other call sites.
- There is no existing helper class under `app/`; `app/Support/` and `app/Services/` exist but none contain a date-SQL helper.

### CHANGES

None — planning task only, no writes performed.

### RISKS

- **Driver detection at query-build time**: `selectRaw` is passed a literal string evaluated by the DB driver. The helper must use `DB::connection()->getDriverName()` (or `config('database.default')` + connection driver lookup) at the time the expression is built. If production `DB_CONNECTION` resolves to `pgsql` while tests resolve to `sqlite`, the same code path produces correct output in both — this is the whole point, and it's already the case per `config/database.php:20`.
- **Line-output format drift**: `to_char(..., 'YYYY-MM')` and `strftime('%Y-%m', ...)` both produce `YYYY-MM` strings used later as array keys (`'Y-m'` at StatsController lines 196/200) and as JSON `month` values. Keep the format literals identical to avoid breaking consumers.
- **Minor risk if a helper file is created**: a new `app/Support/DbDate.php` adds an autoloaded class; the per-controller private-method alternative avoids any autoload/composer-dump step. Mitigation: prefer the private-method approach for this 2-site fix, or run `composer dump-autoload` if a shared helper is chosen.

### BLOCKERS

None. The task is fully scoped and I have a concrete, grounded plan.

---

**Concrete plan (for the implementer):**

Approach selected: **per-controller private helper method** (smallest footprint, no new files/autoload). Both controllers add:

```php
private function monthExpr(string $column): string
{
    return \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::connection()->getDriverName() === 'pgsql'
        ? "to_char({$column}, 'YYYY-MM')"
        : "strftime('%Y-%m', {$column})";
}
```

import re

def extract_keys(src):
    """Extract nested key paths from a TS nested-object source. Tracks braces."""
    # Remove export default { and trailing }
    lines = src.split('\n')
    keys = set()
    current_stack = []  # stack of parent keys
    for line in lines:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        stripped = line.strip().rstrip(',')
        # Skip object-scope closing / opening navigation lines
        # Detect key: value string assignment OR key: { (nested object)
        m = re.match(r"^([\w'+.-]+):", stripped)
        if not m:
            # A line that closes braces: "}," or "},"
            continue
        key = m.group(1).replace("'", '')
        rest = stripped[len(m.group(0)):].lstrip()
        # path so far includes all open object keys on stack
        path = '.'.join(current_stack + [key])
        if rest.startswith('{'):
            # nested object opens
            current_stack.append(key)
            keys.add(path)
        else:
            keys.add(path)
    return keys

def extract(src):
    lines = src.splitlines()

    for idx, raw in enumerate(lines, start=1):

        m = re.match(r"^(\w+):", stripped)
        if m and current_section is not None:

            result[current_section].append((key, idx))

### SUMMARY

Both PostgreSQL-specific `to_char(invoice_date, 'YYYY-MM')` calls are confirmed and can be made SQLite-compatible with a small, driver-aware abstraction. The cleanest fix is a single reusable helper function that returns the correct month-truncation SQL expression depending on the active connection driver (`pgsql` → `to_char(col, 'YYYY-MM')`, `sqlite` → `strftime('%Y-%m', col)`), plus the `groupBy`/`orderBy` reference. This avoids duplicating the driver switch in both controllers and keeps production PostgreSQL behavior identical. The project has no existing date-abstraction helper yet; the DRY-free fallback (inline switch in each controller) would work but is worse for maintenance. I recommend a small helper in `app/Support/` (new namespace) or simply a private method each controller — since only two call sites exist, a lightweight per-controller private method is the lowest-risk, no-new-file option. The plan below gives exact lines and replacement code.

### EVIDENCE

- `app/Http/Controllers/Api/StatsController.php:182-190` — `monthlyRevenue()`:
  ```php
  $rows = (clone $query)
      ->selectRaw(
          "to_char(invoice_date, 'YYYY-MM') as month, "
          .'sum(total_amount) as total, count(*) as count'
      )
      ->groupBy('month')
      ->orderBy('month')
      ->get()
      ->keyBy('month');
  ```
- `app/Http/Controllers/Api/CommercialController.php:345-349` — `stats()`:
  ```php
  $monthly = (clone $base)
      ->selectRaw("to_char(invoice_date, 'YYYY-MM') as month, sum(total_amount) as total, count(*) as count")
      ->groupBy('month')
      ->orderBy('month')
      ->get();
  ```
- `config/database.php:20` — `'default' => env('DB_CONNECTION', 'sqlite')`. Both `pgsql` and `sqlite` connections exist; production uses pgsql, tests use the sqlite default.
- grep across `app/` (112 files) returned exactly these 2 `to_char` matches — no other call sites.
- There is no existing helper class under `app/`; `app/Support/` and `app/Services/` exist but none contain a date-SQL helper.

### CHANGES

None — planning task only, no writes performed.

### RISKS

{

### SUMMARY
I mapped the entire Pekegno backend (Laravel 13/PHP 8.3) against `PLAN_TRAVAUX.md` Phase 3 scope. **Verdict: the Phase 3 backend is functionally complete** — every planned model, migration, controller, route, service, seeder, job, and test from the plan is present and appears fully implemented (business rules, role-scoping, audit logging, OpenAPI annotations, point/penalty/commission logic all wired). No files are empty stubs I observed. The remaining gaps are minor optional items noted as "choix" in the plan (agency snapshot via join rather than DB columns) and cross-cutting concerns like `ActivityLog` export dedup and full unit-test coverage.

### EVIDENCE
- `PLAN_TRAVAUX.md:1-244` — full Phase 3 scope: Client/Commercial/Invoice/Points/Penalties/Promotions v2/Stats/Audit/Settings + frontend (frontend out of scope here). Plan lists 10 new migrations; I found all of them plus supporting ones.
- Models (18, all present) — `backend/app/Models/`: `User, Agency, Department, DepartmentChief, Category, Service, Promotion, PriceHistory, Commercial, CommercialPoint, Invoice, InvoiceItem, InvoicePayment, Setting, ActivityLog, LoginLog, Role, Permission`. Key methods verified: `Commercial::commissionFor` (line 65), `Invoice::refreshStatus` (line 114), `Invoice::agency` BelongsTo (line 45), `Promotion::effectivePrice` (line 45), `Service::oneActivePromotion` (line 50).
- Migrations — `backend/database/migrations/` contains the client fields (`2026_08_05_000001_add_client_fields_to_users`), commercials (`...000002`), commercial_points (`...000003`), settings (`...000004`), promotions v2 discount (`...000005`), invoices (`...000006`), invoice_items (`...000007`), invoice_payments (`...000008`), activity_logs (`...000009`), plus cancelled status and drops of formation tables. No frontend-only items present.
- Controllers (all in `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/`): `ClientController`, `CommercialController`, `InvoiceController`, `PromotionController`, `StatsController`, `SettingController`, `ActivityLogController`, `ExportController`, `UserController`, `AgencyController`, `CategoryController`, `DepartmentController`, `ServiceController`, `RoleController`, `PermissionController`, `UserRoleController`, `UserAssignmentController`, `UploadController`, `ProfileController`, and `Auth/` (`Register/Login/Logout/TwoFactor/ChangePassword/Forgot/Reset/DeleteAccount`). Verification: `InvoiceController.php:97-155` (store w/ number+advance), `:220-269` (pay → points+commission on `paid`), `:283-294` (cancel), `:296-319` (applyPayment); `CommercialController.php` full CRUD + `availableUsers`/`adjustPoints`/`ranking`/`stats`/`search`; `ClientController.php` CRUD + `search`; `PromotionController.php` amount/percent + overlap + price_history; `StatsController.php` overview/agency/monthlyRevenue etc.; `ActivityLogController.php` index with filters.
- Routes — `backend/routes/api.php`: full Phase 3 routes registered with `permission:...` middleware (clients, commercials incl. ranking/stats/adjustPoints/available-users, invoices incl. payments/cancel, promotions, exports, activity-logs, settings, stats cluster). `backend/routes/console.php:8-9` schedules `PenalizeInactiveCommercials` daily at 01:00.
- Services — `backend/app/Services/`: `ActivityLogger` (creates ActivityLog w/ agency+IP+UA, resolved at `ActivityLogger.php:14-44`), `PointsService` (idempotent `awardForSale`, `applyInactivityPenalty`, `recomputeBalance`), `InvoiceNumberGenerator` (`PK-YYYYMMDD-NNN` + PG advisory lock), `AuthService`, `TwoFactorService`.
- Jobs — `backend/app/Jobs/PenalizeInactiveCommercials.php:19-35`: `handle()` queries inactive commercials (`is_active` true, no paid non-cancelled invoice within `inactivity_period_days`) and applies penalty.
- Seeders — `backend/database/seeders/`: `RoleSeeder, PermissionSeeder, SettingSeeder` (6 settings incl. points/penalty/commission/prefix), `DatabaseSeeder`, `CatalogSeeder, AgencySeeder, AdminUserSeeder, UserSeeder`. `SettingSeeder.php:8-14` confirms keys.

This means printed-agency info reflects current agency state, not the state at sale time (plan explicitly noted this risk).
- `ExportController::activityLogs` route exists (`routes/api.php:82`) but I did not read the method body — not verified beyond its route registration and the `ActivityLogger` are wired.
- No dedicated unit tests for `PointsService`/`InvoiceNumberGenerator`/job in `tests/Unit/` (only the `ExampleTest`); coverage lives in the Feature `Phase3Test`.
- The plan's `activity_logs` coverage for auth/2FA/exports relies on explicit loggers (observers + controller calls) rather than a universal `log.activity` middleware — the check `activity-log.consulter`/export dedup is called out but not independently tested.

Most critical remaining pieces are on the **frontend** (out of my scope) and the following backend hardening:
1. Add feature/unit tests for `PointsService` (idempotency of `awardForSale` across re-pays), `InvoiceNumberGenerator` sequence-bump, and the `PenalizeInactiveCommercials` job (deadline logic + `points_balance` decrement).

3. Verify/complete `ExportController::activityLogs` body and its permission wiring end-to-end.

None.

- `StatsController` (`backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/StatsController.php:346`, `:183-184`) and `CommercialController::stats` (`:346`) use PostgreSQL-specific `to_char(...)` SQL for monthly grouping — this will break on non-Postgres databases (e.g. SQLite tests). Mitigation: guard by driver or abstract the date format, as the plan's cross-DB CI is not specified here.
- `InvoiceNumberGenerator` only applies PostgreSQL advisory lock under `pgsql` (`InvoiceNumberGenerator.php:34-36`); on MySQL/SQLite, no lock means concurrent daily-number generation could collide. Mitigation: implement lock for the deployed DB driver.
- `StatsController::overview` sums `total_amount` for `paid` but recalculates `outstanding` from `balance_due` — consistent, but relies on `refreshStatus()` being invoked everywhere payments change; any code path mutating `amount_paid` outside `applyPayment`/`pay` could drift. Mitigation: centralize status recompute.

None.

### SUMMARY
The Pekegno backend defines a complete Laravel API route map in a single `routes/api.php` file. ### EVIDENCE

  - Auth: `POST /auth/logout`, `PUT /auth/change-password`, `DELETE /auth/account`, `GET /user`, `POST /auth/2fa/enable|verify|disable`.
  - Agencies: `GET /agencies/trash`, `POST /agencies/{agency}/restore`, `DELETE .../force-delete`, `apiResource('agencies', ...)`.
